sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pathfinder is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come on in, brother! I've got a job for you. There's been some kind of messy power struggle going on at Ultra lately. I don't get too involved in that stuff, I just need to get in and get out. That's all I care about. But because of all this chaos, nobody really knows what's happening with the exits. Go check them all out for me, yeah?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Visit the Railway Exfil exit
- Visit the Emercom Checkpoint exit
- Visit the Power Station V-Ex exit

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Checked everything twice? Didn't miss anything? Now that's what I call a job well done!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: Visit the 3 extract Interchange. Visiting all locations in a single raid isn't required.
